about.en: HashKey Global is the international cryptocurrency exchange of HashKey Group, offering spot trading, perpetual futures and Launchpool. It holds a Class F Digital Asset Business License from the Bermuda Monetary Authority. It is a separate venue from HashKey Exchange, the group's Hong Kong licensed platform, and from HashKey Chain, the group's blockchain.
about.es: HashKey Global es el exchange internacional de criptomonedas de HashKey Group, que ofrece trading spot, futuros perpetuos y Launchpool. Tiene una licencia Class F Digital Asset Business de la Bermuda Monetary Authority. Es una plataforma distinta de HashKey Exchange, la plataforma del grupo con licencia en Hong Kong, y de HashKey Chain, la blockchain del grupo.
